summary: GitHub watches deduplicate unchanged check conclusions across observations and restarts, and distinguish cancelled checks from failures.

replay.detail: No replay changes. Existing observation facts and persisted message subjects provide deduplication.

schema.detail: No new claim fields, tables, indexes or store version changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Check wake identity now uses the head and counted conclusion set rather than observation and workflow execution IDs. Existing messages remain readable. The existing required_checks.state field can report cancelled; cancelled names are no longer failed names. Optional checks remain excluded when required-check rules are available.

recovery.detail: An older build restores observation-based wake identity and treats cancellation as failure; previously delivered messages are retained.
